name: Fujian Expressway Development Co.,Ltd
summary: Fujian Expressway Development Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment, construction, toll collection, operation, management, and maintenance of expressways in China. The company operates the Fuquan, Quanzhou-Xiamen, Fuzhou-Quanzhou, Luoning, and Punan expressways. It also provides expressway advertising, electronic toll collection card, road clearing, and business development services. Fujian Expressway Development Co.,Ltd was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Fuzhou, China.
